title: Urgent: Medical Equipment Needed for Mary & Lydia
excerpt: Help us provide essential medical equipment: orthopedic boot shoes, ergonomic wheelchairs, and crutches for Mary & Lydia.
author: AbleHearts Team
content:
# Urgent Medical Needs for Mary & Lydia Mary and Lydia are **physically challenged women** living in rural Kenya who urgently need medical equipment to improve their mobility, independence, and quality of life. ## Immediate Medical Needs #### Lydia's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Lydia's testimonial on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751420) #### Mary's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Mary's story on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751723) ### For Mary 1. **Orthopedic Boot Shoes** - Custom-fitted medical footwear to support her mobility 2. **Ergonomic Wheelchair** - Adjustable wheelchair for daily activities and independence 3. **Medical Crutches** - Ergonomic crutches to assist with walking and balance ### For Lydia 1. **Standing Wheelchair** or **Ergonomic Wheelchair** - Therapeutic wheelchair that allows both sitting and standing positions 2. **Mobility Aids** - Additional support equipment as recommended by medical professionals ## Why These Items Are Critical ### Orthopedic Boot Shoes for Mary - Provide proper foot support and alignment - Reduce pain during daily activities - Prevent further physical complications - Enable safer movement around the home and community ### Ergonomic Wheelchair for Mary - Offers adjustable seating for comfort during extended use - Provides independence for daily tasks - Reduces physical strain on caregivers - Enables participation in community activities ### Standing Wheelchair for Lydia - Therapeutic benefits of standing position - Improves circulation and bone health - Provides psychological benefits of eye-level interaction - Reduces pressure sores from prolonged sitting - Supports Lydia's remarkable cognitive abilities by enabling better participation ### Medical Crutches for Mary - Ergonomic design reduces hand and wrist strain - Adjustable height for proper posture - Durable construction for long-term use - Improves balance and confidence while walking ## The Current Situation Mary and Lydia face daily challenges due to **lack of proper medical equipment**: - **Limited Mobility**: Unable to move freely within and outside their home - **Dependency**: Require constant assistance for basic activities - **Health Risks**: Improper support leads to additional physical strain - **Social Isolation**: Difficulty participating in community activities - **Lost Opportunities**: Lydia's photographic memory and potential limited by mobility constraints ## How You Can Help ### Option 1: Monetary Donation Your financial contribution helps us purchase **locally-sourced** medical equipment that meets Mary & Lydia's specific needs. **Donate at**: [/donate](/donate) ### Option 2: Purchase & Ship Direct Can't donate money but want to help? Purchase the items and ship directly to our secure address. **View Wishlist**: *[/shop](/shop) - Contact us via [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/254107145882)* ### Option 3: Medical Equipment Donations Have gently used medical equipment? We accept: - Wheelchairs (manual or electric) - Crutches and walking aids - Orthopedic footwear - Other mobility devices **Contact us**: [WhatsApp +254 107 145 882](https://wa.me/254107145882) ## Estimated Costs While costs vary, here are approximate estimates for quality equipment:
| Item | Estimated Cost (USD) | |------|---------------------| | Orthopedic Boot Shoes | $150 - $300 | | Ergonomic Wheelchair | $400 - $800 | | Standing Wheelchair | $800 - $1,500 | | Medical Crutches | $50 - $150 | | **Total** | **$1,400 - $2,750** |
**Note**: Local sourcing in Kenya may reduce costs. Any amount helps! ## Impact of Your Donation ### With Proper Equipment, Mary Can: - ✅ Move independently around the home - ✅ Participate in community activities - ✅ Reduce physical pain and strain - ✅ Care for Lydia and her niece more effectively - ✅ Pursue small income-generating activities ### With Proper Equipment, Lydia Can: - ✅ Maintain better physical health - ✅ Engage socially at eye level with others - ✅ Pursue education and skill development - ✅ Utilize her photographic memory more effectively - ✅ Build towards greater independence ## Transparency & Accountability Every donation is tracked and reported: - 📸 Photo/video updates of equipment delivery - 📄 Receipts and invoices shared with donors - 📊 Monthly transparency reports - 💬 Direct updates via [WhatsApp Channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB81btJENy6GLqfBW0q) ## Frequently Asked Questions **Q: Why buy equipment instead of providing cash?** A: Medical equipment is a **one-time investment** that provides long-term benefits. It empowers Mary & Lydia with independence and improved health for years to come. **Q: Can I buy equipment locally in Kenya for them?** A: Yes! If you're in Kenya or know local suppliers, contact us on [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/254107145882) to coordinate direct delivery. **Q: How do I know the equipment will actually reach them?** A: We provide photo/video proof of delivery and encourage donors to follow our [WhatsApp Channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB81btJENy6GLqfBW0q) for real-time updates. **Q: Can I donate used medical equipment?** A: Absolutely! As long as it's in good working condition and suitable for their needs. Contact us to arrange shipping logistics. **Q: What happens if you receive more donations than needed for equipment?** A: Excess funds go toward: 1. Equipment maintenance and repairs 2. Medical consultations and fittings 3. Monthly living expenses (food, housing, education) 4. Emergency medical care All allocations are transparently reported. ## Take Action Today Mary and Lydia need this equipment **urgently**. Every day without proper support means: - Continued physical pain - Lost opportunities for independence - Increased caregiver burden - Greater health risks ### Donate Now [**Make a Donation →**](/donate) ### Share This Appeal Help us reach people who can make a difference: - Share on social media - Forward to friends and family - Post in community groups - Join our [WhatsApp Channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB81btJENy6GLqfBW0q) for updates ### Contact Us Questions? Need more info? - **WhatsApp**: [+254 107 145 882](https://wa.me/254107145882) - **Email**: [donations@able-hearts.org](mailto:donations@able-hearts.org) - **Channel**: [WhatsApp Updates](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB81btJENy6GLqfBW0q) - **X(Twitter)**: [AbleHearts](https://x.com/able_hearts_ke) --- **Together, we can restore mobility, dignity, and hope for Mary & Lydia.** *AbleHearts - Borderless giving. Dignity in action.*
